messages:
Samira L.: Hey everyone  I have two onboarding events in my calendar for the same orientation. Both show 9:00 PT but one is Zoom and the other is Google Meet. Which one should I join? The ICS I imported doesn't show the breakout track links either.

Priya N.: Same issue here, Gmail auto-added both. I'm in IST so duplicates are annoying with reminders. The Meet link has a different join URL.

Tom W.: I RSVP'd to the Zoom invite then got another invite titled 'Onboarding (recurring)'. Who's the organizer on the canonical event?

DevEx Maya: Hey all  apologies for the mess. During invite cleanup the organizer field got duplicated which caused two different client behaviors. Canonical event = Zoom invite from onboarding@redwood.com (please join that one). We've removed the Meet entry on our side but cached events can linger. If you see duplicate, delete the one with "Meet" in the location and keep the Zoom.

DevEx Maya: Breakout tracks: we created separate calendar events for each track so you can add them ahead of time. Schedule summary:
- PT session: 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET (main)
- EMEA repeat: 08:00 UTC / 09:00 CET
- APAC: recorded session + optional Q&A drop-in (link posted after live)

Priya N.: Thanks. For the breakout links — will they be in the main event description or separate events? I want to pre-add the Product track.

DevEx Maya: You can do either. Hosts will post breakout join links in Zoom chat during the session, but we also attached dedicated "Track: Product" and "Track: Engineering" events so you can pre-add them. If your client doesn't show the new events, try re-importing the iCal below.

DevEx Maya: Fallback iCal import (copy/paste -> save as .ics then import):
```
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//redwood//ONBOARDING 2026//EN
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:onboard-track-product-2026
DTSTART:20260324T170000Z
SUMMARY:Track: Product (Onboarding)
DESCRIPTION:Zoom link: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/2222222222?pwd=product
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
```

Samira L.: I use Apple Calendar and had to force-refresh the calendar subscription to see updates. Also FYI my client changed my reminder to 10 min. Any recommended default?

DevEx Maya: We recommend a 30 min reminder for cross-TZ attendees so you have time to join and test audio. If you need us to add the product track to your calendar manually, DM me and I will.

Tom W.: Quick question: will the recording be edited for sensitive info? I demo sample data that has internal IDs. Should I avoid showing that?

DevEx Maya: Good call — please avoid sharing credentials or sensitive dashboards during live demos. We do quick review of recordings and trim PII segments when flagged, but it's faster if presenters avoid it up front. Recordings will be uploaded to the onboarding drive and marked internal.

calendar-bot: Recording uploaded for 09:00 PT orientation: https://drive.redwood.com/onboarding/recordings/orientation-2026-03-24-0900pt.mp4

Priya N.: Awesome, thanks! I'll delete the Meet duplicate and add the Product track event. :party_parrot:
